title: Search-form test: which issued string carries an unindexed deposit into composition
instruction: Operator, 2026-10-11 23:11 EDT: "lets test this before deciding. heres how an unindexed one composed with axn and title". The decision pending: whether the record pages' 'Search this title (exact match)' link carries the title alone (current, 1,473 pages) or the title with the AXN.
not_captures: A run that composes without engaging an archive source, at a new address, is not a capture (operator, 2026-09-11); such runs are kept here as test data, transcripts verbatim. A run that engages the archive is seated in the Capture Registry and referenced here by slug.

reading_so_far: Runs 1 and 2 differ in form and in two conditions besides: #1675's subject had been captured the day before (v12.101, on the mirror) and its field is thin; #1673's subject had no capture and a dense field (the OpenAI release was news). The difference in outcome cannot yet be assigned to the form.

Where a field exists, the title's terms are composed from it: the archive's claim in the title ('One Corporate Author Line') reaches the composition as the field's controversy, with no attribution to the archive.
Identifiers alone carry nothing or bind to their neighbours.
Unindexed #1574 (runs 3–5): title, AXN plus title, and title without its designation all compose from the title's own words, read as the querent's draft; no archive source. The AXN changes nothing.

Indexed #1556 (runs 6–8): the AXN alone misbinds to its neighbour row; AXN plus title composes generically with no cards; the title alone reaches a citing surface (operativesemiotics.org), not the record page.
Runs 3–8 were unquoted; the record-page link is quoted. Not yet tested: the quoted title against the unquoted title on one deposit.

Signed in, 2026-10-12 (runs 9–17): every run that cites the archive reaches a listing row (Browse, Wiki) or the author's Academia surfaces, never the record page. Identity is carried at up to full precision; content is carried only where Academia holds the abstract (#1627, the criterion verbatim and attributed).
Where nothing holds the content, the composition supplies it from the title at the field's grain, and for #1603 the field's default is the reading the paper refutes.

Three runs cite no source and compose a substitute: an essay (#996), a prose tale in place of a poem (#1197), an invented specification (#166). All three were unquoted; of the four unquoted runs, only #637 cited the archive (an Academia tag page and two listing rows). The five quoted runs all cited the archive.
next: #1556 quoted title (the link as issued) against run 8, so quoting is the only variable.

Runs: 4 ≈ 3, 7 < 8, 6 misbound; run 8 (unquoted) reached a citing surface.
decision.applied: 1,473 record pages, replaced in place by rebuild/record-pages/insert_search_this_title.py; the renderer (wire_deposit.search_this_title_html) emits the same line.
